Name: Chummy Fix
Author: itslittany
Description:
Chummy Fix allows you to fix the odds of a drop appearing in your farm's fish pond(s). You can only produce valid items based on the fish in the pond.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
Once you have followed the installation steps above and started the game once, you will see a new file in the mod folder called [code]config.json[/code]. Edit the config file in a text editor like Notepad to change the probability of an item spawning in your Pond's chum bucket. Values are a percentage between 0 and 100.

Updated to work with the latest release of Stardew!
